This '''individual''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When [[Unidentified librarian|her father]], a librarian, was captured by [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] during a police action, she led a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Rebels in liberating the both her father and the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. She also took a prisoner of her own, the CompForcer [[Zevulon Veers]], who professed his wish to defect to the Alliance. Initially she was distrustful of Veers, but was won over by her father's testimony after Veers gave medical aid to the wounded librarian.
